items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Oh, you knew the Red? Red Nichols, you mean? No, no.

ctx.x: That's right. Was the original Dixieland jazz band in New York when you were there, do you think? No. Because they were there just before the Lord. You knew that guy they called?
Oh, you knew the Red? Red Nichols, you mean? No, no.
No. No. What was his name? Monkey?
-- Manuel was playing out on PAULINA, and -- with Red Nichols.
